content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-56. - Procedure on default.

             …

faqs.a:
Upon default in the performance of any construction contract under this article, the
               city manager, the engineer or any purchasing officer, as directed by motion of the
               council, may advertise and may relet the remainder of the work without further ordinance
               or resolution and may deduct the cost from the original contract price and may recover
               any excess cost by suit on the original bond, or otherwise.
(Code 1981, § 27-57; Ord. No. 551, § 19(H), 5-14-1964)
State Law reference—
Procedure on default, C.R.S. § 31-25-516.
